title: Improving Pediatric Emergency Department Triage with Modality Dropout in Late Fusion Multimodal EHR Models

bias_targets.methodology: Training a multimodal EHR triage model exclusively on adult patient data and evaluating its zero-shot generalization and performance disparities on a pediatric cohort, including an age-stratified error analysis across specific developmental age groups (Infants, Toddlers, School Age, and Adolescents).
